Merger Consideration is defined as the Stock Election Consideration or Cash Election Consideration, with Cash Election defined in Section 1.7(a)(i)(B); The target holders will receive Merger Consideration in the Contemplated Transactions, and a fairness opinion confirms the consideration is fair.
- New Wildlife Common Stock (Stock Election) per share: Stock Election Exchange Ratio (Stock Election Consideration).
- Cash per share (Cash Election): Per Share Cash Price in cash, without interest (Cash Election Consideration).
- Cash in lieu of fractional New Wildlife Common Stock: cash payable for fractional shares as described in Section 1.11.
- Dividends on the Merger Consideration: aggregate dividends payable with respect to the Merger Consideration (both prior to surrender and on subsequent payment dates) as described in Section 1.9(f).
- Excluded Shares and Dissenting Shares: not entitled to Merger Consideration.
Stock Election Exchange Ratio (the number of New Wildlife Common Stock per Company Class A Common Stock) is the ratio used to determine Stock Election Consideration for Stock Electing Shares; Cash Election is determined by the Per Share Cash Price; the exact numeric value of the Stock Election Exchange Ratio is not provided in the excerpts (the document references a Share Consolidation Ratio set forth in the Recitals).
